summary: In 2025, Poland's GDP was USD 1,035,491,784,197.44 with GDP per capita of USD 28,419.5777 and inflation of 3.8142%. As of 2026-06-01, the 10-year bond yield was 5.51%, and on 2026-09-12 the exchange rate was 0.268572 USD per 1 PLN with an fx_change_pct of 0.019. Historical series are provided for GDP, GDP per capita, and inflation from 2016 to 2025, bond yields from 2016 to 2026, and FX rates from 2020 to 2026, with no nulls in these ranges but earlier years unavailable.
